name: glyhub_GPST000738_N_B4GalT1
title: Galactosylation of bovine fetuin N-glycans in an enzyme reactor
description: N-glycan profiles from bovine fetuin treated with an immobilised B4GalT1 reactor. The experiment examines galactose addition to desialylated, degalactosylated fetuin over repeated injections at two flow rates. It contains nine glycan and isomer features measured across 18 source observations.
details:
The substrate is foetal bovine serum fetuin treated with sialidase and galactosidase. Four substrate-control columns are followed by two observations at each of 2, 4 and 8 hours at 25 microlitres/minute, and at 0, 2, 4 and 8 hours at 75 microlitres/minute. The first 25 microlitres/minute injection was excluded in the source study because of acquisition loss and poor signal.

Abundance is expressed as a percentage within the A2 or A3 glycan family, not of the total glycome. Flow and time are recorded in colData. The repeated control table is represented once; the columns do not establish biological replication or pairing.

Twelve A2/A2G1 treatment cells with duplicated, non-closing source values and twelve A3 control cells with unresolved cross-table correspondence are NA. Six additional zero measurements are NA. Original values and the separate masks remain in metadata. Summing the available values therefore need not give 100.
unit: percentage within the source glycan family
annotation: Nine typed compositions retain distinct source isomer labels. Four fully localized structures from Supplementary Figure S3 are encoded; ambiguous antennae and unresolved isomer mappings retain diagram evidence.
table: Supplementary Table 1, sheets 1 and 2; composition comparisons in sheets 5 and 6; Figure S3

name: glyhub_GPST000738_N_ST6GAL1
title: Sialylation of bovine fetuin N-glycans in an enzyme reactor
description: N-glycan profiles from desialylated bovine fetuin passed through an immobilised ST6GAL1 reactor. The experiment follows redistribution among sialylated forms of three precursor families during repeated injections at 25 and 75 microlitres/minute. Ten glycan features are represented across 28 source observations.
details:
Seven substrate-control columns accompany seven reactor observations at 25 microlitres/minute and fourteen at 75 microlitres/minute. Injection times are 0, 2, 4 and 8 hours. The 25 microlitres/minute series has one 0-hour column and two at each later time; the 75 microlitres/minute series has four at 0, 2 and 8 hours and two at 4 hours.

Values are fractions within the H6N5, H5N5 or H5N4 precursor family. They must not be interpreted as total-glycome fractions or mixed directly with the percentage scale of the B4GalT1 dataset.

Thirteen source n.d. values are NA. Ten 25 microlitres/minute 0-hour measurements are also NA because their omission from processed sheet 7 is unexplained. An extra processed-table control lacks a raw-table identity and remains in metadata as unmatched observations. The repeated control table is represented once; biological replicate type is unresolved.
unit: fraction within the source precursor glycan family
annotation: Ten typed compositions describe sialylated forms. Four fully localized Figure S3 structures are encoded; diagrams retain the evidence for unresolved positional forms.
table: Supplementary Table 1, sheets 3 and 4; composition comparisons in sheets 7 and 8; Figure S3

name: glyhub_GPST000643_O_S5
title: Fucosidase treatment of porcine colonic mucin O-glycans
description: LC-MS profiles of porcine colonic mucin oligosaccharides exposed to individual Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron fucosidases. This experiment compares the effects of GH95 and GH29 enzymes on a complex O-glycan substrate containing different fucosylated epitopes. Supplementary Table S5 provides 108 features and 22 observations.
details:
The conditions are a no-enzyme control and BT1777, BT3155, BT3173, BT1842, BT3665, BT1625, BT4136, BT3798, BT3956 and BT4713. Each condition has columns labelled Replicate 1 and Replicate 2; these labels alone do not identify biological versus technical replicates.

The source supplies glycan AUCs, retention times and percentages normalized to total glycan AUC per observation. The abundance assay uses the percentages. Fucose, sulfation and blood-group annotations are retained as source annotations, including their zero-valued categorical flags. Features include substrate glycans and enzymatic products; O-derived denotes their experimental origin.
unit: percentage of source total glycan AUC
annotation: All 108 source composition labels are retained as typed compositions. Forty-seven source putative structures have explicit encodings; remaining structural descriptions are preserved as text without completing unspecified linkages.

name: glyhub_GPST000643_O_S7
title: GH89 treatment of porcine gastric mucin O-glycans
description: Porcine gastric mucin oligosaccharide profiles used to compare the GH89 enzymes BT0438 and BT4359 from Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron. The experiment investigates cleavage of terminal alpha-linked N-acetylglucosamine groups on a complex mucin substrate. Supplementary Table S7 contains 77 features across six observations.
details:
The no-enzyme control, BT0438 treatment and BT4359 treatment each have two source-labelled replicates. The assay contains total-AUC-normalized percentages; original AUC and retention-time entries are retained separately in metadata.

Source row 46 has a disagreement between its reported composition and putative structure residue counts. Rows 69 and 70 contain the unresolved composition token HexHAc, so their typed compositions are NA. Original labels and the annotation_consistency field identify these cases. Their quantitative measurements are retained; uncertain molecular assignments should be considered before feature-level interpretation.
unit: percentage of source total glycan AUC
annotation: Seventy-five compositions are parsed and 67 putative structures are encoded. Original structures and two unparsed composition labels remain available in rowData.

name: glyhub_GPST000643_O_S9B
title: GH2 treatment of bovine submaxillary mucin O-glycans
description: O-glycan-derived LC-MS profiles from bovine submaxillary mucin treated with six Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron GH2 enzymes. The experiment compares galactosidase activity on an intact complex mucin glycan substrate, including its sialylated and substituted forms. Supplementary Table S9B contains 56 features and seven observations.
details:
The seven source columns represent a control and separate treatments with BT1626, BT3179, BT3340, BT4050, BT4241 and BT4684. No replicate labels are supplied for these columns. This table concerns bovine submaxillary mucin without the sialidase/fucosidase pretreatment used in the separate S9C experiment.

Abundances are percentages of total source glycan AUC. Source galactose, sialylation, sulfate and fucose annotations accompany the molecular labels. A single column per condition should not be interpreted as replicated evidence for treatment effects.
unit: percentage of source total glycan AUC
annotation: Typed compositions cover the 56 features, with 40 encoded putative structures. Unresolved linkage descriptions remain in their original notation.

name: glyhub_GPST000643_O_S10B
title: GH20 activity on O-glycans from pretreated PSGL-1
description: O-glycan measurements from P-selectin glycoprotein ligand-1 (PSGL-1) expressing core 4 after pretreatment and exposure to Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron GH20 enzymes. This screening experiment examines removal of exposed N-acetylglucosamine from O-glycan core structures. The O-glycan section of Supplementary Table S10B supplies nine features across eight conditions.
details:
The protein substrate was pretreated with BT0455 sialidase and the galactosidases BT1626 and BT4241 to expose terminal N-acetylglucosamine. The eight conditions are control, BT1621, BT1627, BT3178, BT3598, BT3868, BT4394 and BT4681. There is one source column per condition; biological replicate type and expression-system species are not established by these table columns.

Only the source O-glycan section is included here. Its N-glycan section is available as glyhub_GPST000643_N_S10B. Percentages retain the denominator supplied in the workbook; separating the sections does not renormalize either matrix. Source mass/isomer labels are local to the table and are not universal glycan identifiers.
unit: percentage of source total glycan AUC
annotation: All nine source compositions and putative structures have typed representations, including reduced termini where specified.

name: glyhub_GPST000643_N_S10B
title: GH20 activity on N-glycans from pretreated PSGL-1

These measurements describe three N-glycan features with exposed N-acetylglucosamine in the pretreated glycoprotein preparation, permitting inspection of enzyme responses outside the O-glycan core panel. Supplementary Table S10B reports the three features across eight conditions.
details:
The protein substrate was pretreated with BT0455 sialidase and the galactosidases BT1626 and BT4241 to expose terminal N-acetylglucosamine. The eight conditions are control, BT1621, BT1627, BT3178, BT3598, BT3868, BT4394 and BT4681. There is one source column per condition; biological replicate type and expression-system species are not established by these table columns.

This object follows the workbook's explicit N-glycan classification rather than combining these features with its O-glycan section. Compare glyhub_GPST000643_O_S10B for the complementary feature space.
unit: percentage of source total glycan AUC
annotation: The three composition labels and putative structures are encoded, including the source reduced reducing ends.

name: glyhub_GPST000643_O_S10C
title: Replicated GH20 measurements of PSGL-1 O-glycan core features
description: O-glycan core measurements from pretreated PSGL-1 expressing core 4, used to compare selected Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron GH20 enzymes. details:
The conditions are control, BT3178, BT3598, BT3868 and BT4681, each with Sample 1, Sample 2 and Sample 3. PSGL-1 expressing core 4 was pretreated with an enzyme mix. The expression-system species and biological versus technical replicate type are not established by these table columns. Percentages retain the source total-AUC denominator without renormalization after separation by glycan class.

The two N-glycan features from S10C are available in glyhub_GPST000643_N_S10C. Both objects describe the same observation columns; they are complementary feature partitions, not separate biological samples.

annotation: All three source compositions and putative structures are encoded. Reduced termini follow the source assignments.
table: Supplementary Table S10C, O-glycan rows 8-10 (media-11.xlsx); classification supported by S10B O-glycan rows 10, 14 and 15

name: glyhub_GPST000643_O_S11B
title: Colonic mucin O-glycan degradation by enzyme mixtures
description: Porcine colonic mucin oligosaccharide profiles after treatment with a Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron enzyme mixture, with or without BT3868. The experiment tests how adding this GH20 enzyme changes the residual glycans and digestion products after combined removal of terminal residues and substituents. Supplementary Table S11B contains 60 features across nine observations.
details:
Three source-labelled samples are reported for each of a no-enzyme control, an eleven-enzyme mixture and the same mixture supplemented with BT3868. The base mixture contains BT0455, BT4243, BT1625, BT3173, BT1636, BT1624, BT1626, BT4241, BT1628, BT4681 and BT0438. This is the S11B mixture; it does not include the additional BT4394 used in the distinct S11C experiment.

Measurements are percentages of source total glycan AUC. O-derived features include remaining substrate glycans and released enzymatic products. Sample 1-3 labels are retained without assigning a biological replicate type or pairing the conditions.
unit: percentage of source total glycan AUC
annotation: Compositions are typed for all features and 27 putative structures are encoded. Ambiguous structural text remains available for the other features.
table: Supplementary Table S11B, sheet named Table 11B (media-12.xlsx)

name: glyhub_GPST000643_O_S12
title: Gastric mucin oligosaccharides remaining after bacterial growth
description: LC-MS profiles of oligosaccharides in culture supernatants after growth of Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron on porcine gastric mucin O-glycans. Wild-type and fucosidase-deficient strains are compared with the glycan substrate control to examine the contribution of fucose removal to mucin utilization. Supplementary Table S12 contains 140 features and four observations.
details:
The source conditions are Control (gMO), the double alpha-1,2-fucosidase deletion strain lacking bt3173 and bt4682, that double deletion with an additional bt1842 deletion, and wild-type B. thetaiotaomicron. These are culture-supernatant glycan profiles, not bacterial counts or gene-expression measurements. One percentage column is available for each condition; no biological replicate type is assigned.

Percentages are normalized to source total glycan AUC. Feature row 48 has conflicting composition and putative-structure residue counts; both source assignments are retained and flagged in annotation_consistency. Digestion products and residual substrate glycans should be interpreted together in this extracellular measurement space.
unit: percentage of source total glycan AUC
annotation: Typed compositions retain source mass/isomer labels, and 95 putative structures are encoded. Ambiguous source structures remain as text.
table: Supplementary Table S12, sheet named Table 12 (media-13.xlsx)

name: glyhub_GPST000213_N_CTX_M
title: Mouse CTX (M) N-glycan source peak profiles
description: Complete source-defined N-glycan peak-intensity matrix for mouse CTX (M). The repository includes wild-type and Slc39a8 A391T mutant observations; specimen labels and source genotypes are retained where given.
details: 130 quantified source peaks are retained, including peaks without resolved molecular annotation. This is the complete raw-intensity block of the processed workbook, not raw MS reprocessing. Peaks are indexed within the source sheet; no mass-tolerance matching or inter-tissue alignment is imposed. Published normalized and signal-to-noise tables remain in the original workbook; they are not substituted for the intensity assay. Sex and specimen labels are source-defined. Glycan composition is unknown for these peak-level features because the separate rounded-mass annotation list has no exact source feature key. Source QC: the full 130-value raw-intensity vectors for M480 (WT, source G) and M11 (MUT, source I) are identical, as are M10 (MUT, source H) and M444 (MUT, source K). All four source columns are preserved, but their analysis assay values are masked as NA because source sample provenance cannot be resolved. No member of either pair is guessed to be correct. The repository combines wild-type profiling with Slc39a8 A391T data discussed in the related study (DOI: 10.1038/s41380-022-01490-1); the linked Nature Communications data-availability statement explicitly identifies this shared accession.
annotation: No molecular annotation is inferred from mass alone; source m/z labels remain available.

name: glyhub_GPST000533_N_Glycopeptides
title: Desialylated haptoglobin glycopeptides in sepsis serum
description: Haptoglobin purified from healthy-control and sepsis serum was analyzed by LC-ESI MS after desialylation. The complete six-panel source table contains three HC0, three SG1 and three SG2 observations.
details: The source protein is UniProt P00738. All six quantitative panels in the selected author sheet are retained: Site 3 (3+), Site 4 (4+ and 3+), Site 2 (3+ and 2+), and oxidized Site 1 (3+). Charge states are distinct features, not independent samples, and are not summed. All panels have matching sample and raw-data identifiers.
